items.title: 70399_Theodore _Red_ Saunders oral history interview
items.q: he and Sammy Dyer -- Sammy Dyer was a great choreographer here who did shows for the Club Delisa.

ctx.x: Yes, right, right down there, I mean, -- yeah, Royal Frolics, I think, was the name of the club, because at one time they turned -- then they brought Billie Holiday in there later. But later years. But he and Sammy Dyer -- Sammy Dyer was a great choreographer here who did shows for the Club Delisa. Also, he did the -- he did a lot of work for Mrs. Abbott with the Abbott girls in the Palmer House, yeah, when they had the Empire Room, first started out they started out with this great big line of girls and things,…
And Tiny used to do a lot of writing them.
